gloss_en: How do I create and load my own classification into BlenderBIM so I can classify modelled elements? Must the file be an IFC already containing the classification?
title_original: BlenderBIM - Classification References Manual Entry or Classification Source
question_paraphrase: how do i make my own classification and load it in blenderbim so i can tag the elements i modelled? does the classification file have to be an ifc file?
phrasing_notes: plain, slightly tentative; asks two questions in one post; no file attached
answer_summary: Built-in libraries live in the add-on schema/classifications folder as IFC; custom ones can be built from an XML file converted with getIfcClassification.py from the IfcClassification repo; no validator known.

gloss_en: What does Bonsai still need so I can use it to produce a basic council-submission drawing pack for small projects in about 10 sheets a day?
title_original: What does Bonsai need to be ready for a basic architectural drawing pack?
question_paraphrase: what is still missing in bonsai before i can recommend it for council submission drawings on small houses and sheds - plans, sections, elevations, schedules, site plan with survey background?
phrasing_notes: long structured wish-list; practical architect voice; mentions local window types and permit checks (sewer connection, door swing, extinguishers)
answer_summary: Others agreed and added: tessellated line rendering, multi-object editing, configurable line/text styles, in-app sheet layout, DXF/DWG exchange, window/door schedules, regional presets.

gloss_en: I cannot add a nosing dimension in the BlenderBIM stair editor - is that an IFC limitation or just missing in the tool?
title_original: Stair tread nosing
question_paraphrase: cant find where to add nosing in the stair parameters. is this an ifc limit or just not in the editor yet?
phrasing_notes: short, asks IFC-vs-tool-limit question; uses 'nosing' which commenters note is also the SA/US term
answer_summary: IFC has NosingLength in the stair flight Pset; a feature request existed; a nosing field and stair pitch were later added to the editor.

gloss_en: A firm wants paid remote help modelling construction details in BlenderBIM and annotating them in Revit; an SA architect volunteers.
title_original: Paid work using BlenderBIM
question_paraphrase: looking for people to model large-scale construction details in blenderbim, final annotation will be done in revit because annotation tools are not mature
phrasing_notes: job-post style; SA architect says he is keen but unfamiliar with the International Building Code
answer_summary: Only BlenderBIM needed; firm handles code; a commenter found IFC4 classification bugs in the spreadsheet script.

gloss_en: I built a hobby tool that turns IFC into compact browser databases with 4D/5D, clash review and MEP bills of quantities using SMM2 sections; are the mappings sensible?
title_original: RFC on BIM Strategic Position Paper
question_paraphrase: asking domain experts to sanity check my ifc-to-browser tool: smm section mappings for MEP boq, country rate templates, addressing elements by guid via ifc:// links
phrasing_notes: self-aware disclaimer about AI-assisted research; asks for human expert review
answer_summary: Replies suggested an ifc:// URL scheme for git/CDE-hosted files and addressing single elements/properties by GUID, beyond BCF-style sets.

gloss_en: Has anyone used BlenderBIM or Topologic for TM59 overheating assessments - is there a free workflow?
title_original: TM59
question_paraphrase: anyone done tm59 summer overheating checks with blenderbim, blender or topologic? is there a foss workflow?
context_given: South Africa SANS 10400 XA does not require TM59
phrasing_notes: organisation-level ask, low urgency ('important but not urgent')
answer_summary: Ladybug/Grasshopper or DesignBuilder best; Topologic could be extended with EnergyPlus expertise; SANS 10400 XA uses simpler glazing/ventilation ratios.

gloss_en: Proposal to add REUSE and DISASSEMBLE values to the IFC Element Status property to support circular construction; a Johannesburg salvage company is cited.
title_original: Reuse and disassembly in Construction : from Abyss to Zen
question_paraphrase: collecting actors, books and standards on reuse/disassembly; proposing REUSE and DISASSEMBLE tags in element status for ifc 4.4
phrasing_notes: curated A-to-Z list style; community invited to extend
answer_summary: Issue tracked in buildingSMART IFC4.4 repo; commenters said such values did not exist and are a necessary first step.

gloss_en: Browser tool that generates editable IFC from a plain-language brief; is the IFC clean enough (types, psets, spatial structure)?
title_original: Text to IFC in the browser, built on IfcOpenShell. Looking for feedback
question_paraphrase: i built a tool that makes real ifc entities from a text brief - walls slabs openings spaces. is the output clean enough to use and what features would you want?
phrasing_notes: product-feedback tone; testers report slow generation (~6 min) and viewer bug
answer_summary: Testers found results impressive but slow; suggested clarifying questions for vague briefs and a massing-first staged process.

gloss_en: Are there open-source tools for 4D scheduling and 5D costing linked to IFC model elements, as alternatives to Synchro?
title_original: [BlenderBIM & CharonIFC] Construction Project Planning, and Cost Scheduling
question_paraphrase: any open source way to link schedule tasks to model elements for 4D and cost for 5D? something like synchro but free
phrasing_notes: wish-list of QS features: quantity takeoff linked to geometry, cost database, standard measurement rules, interim valuations
answer_summary: No mature option; BlenderBIM sequence module and P6-XML-to-IFC scripts emerging; IfcRelSequence linking and costing still missing.

gloss_en: Quantity surveyor in Nigeria: can IFC carry cost data (rates, man-hours, equipment output) and can BlenderBIM produce a bill of quantities?
title_original: Welcome to the OSArch Community - Introduce yourself here (QS cost estimating)
question_paraphrase: i am a QS with 15 years in nigeria, freecad and blender are not suitable for QS. can ifc hold unit rates, labour hours, equipment output, overheads? i planned to parse ifc in python to a boq spreadsheet
phrasing_notes: first-person career intro, domain terms: unit rates, preliminaries, overheads, BOQ
answer_summary: IFC has IfcCostSchedule/IfcCostItem but nobody known to implement it; suggested LibreOffice Base link; BlenderBIM CSV export practical.

gloss_en: Lagos architect wants to integrate BlenderBIM into a Blender-based design pipeline, dislikes Revit, finds complex scripting hard.

phrasing_notes: personal intro, casual, admits skill limits
answer_summary: Intro post; no technical answer, welcomed to community.

gloss_en: South Africa's cidb leads a National BIM Adoption Strategy 2025-2030: national framework, digital project information systems, BIM procurement guidance, steering committee, 2026 phase on governance and standards.
title_original: cidb BIM Adoption Strategy
question_paraphrase: official page: BIM as performance improvement approach; national BIM steering committee nominations; no mention of IFC, openBIM or ISO 19650
phrasing_notes: formal policy register, outcome-focused (delays, cost overruns, fragmented information)
answer_summary: Roadmap 2025-2030+ with governance and standards development in 2026; IFC not named.

gloss_en: Georeference panel shows three decimals and cm units - confusing; should always be metres and show EPSG?
title_original: Geo-reference, no decimals after mm.
question_paraphrase: why does geo-reference show mm precision and units in cm? should map coordinates always be metres? show the epsg code
context_given: Ghana UTM projects use feet or metres depending on CRS
phrasing_notes: terse UI complaint, proposes fix itself
answer_summary: Extra precision avoids federation mismatch errors; map units default to project units; add metre as length unit then set map unit; issue filed upstream.

gloss_en: How to define custom quantity take-off calculations, e.g. rebar weight from concrete volume; Ghana practice quotes slab mesh in kg/m2 and beams/columns in kg/m3.
title_original: [How to] Create a custom Qto calculation
question_paraphrase: how do i make a custom qto rule for rebar? in ghana mesh is kg per m2, beams and columns kg per m3
phrasing_notes: practical local-convention explanation
answer_summary: Use Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral ReinforcementVolumeRatio where possible; ReinforcementAreaRatio is not a steel weight; sweep modifier not exported to IFC yet.

gloss_en: How can I automatically federate separate IFC projects, each with local grid, using their geolocation (Ghana UTM zone 30N)?
title_original: [Ifc] federating ifcProjects with geolocation
question_paraphrase: each building is modelled at its own local origin with geolocation; how do I join them in one map position without moving every model to global coords?
phrasing_notes: technical, CRS jargon
answer_summary: Model at 0,0 and use IfcPatch OffsetObjectPlacement and MergeProject; automatic federation by geolocation not supported; align origins manually.

gloss_en: Importing a resource CSV into BlenderBIM 4D gives Key Error Activity/Resource Name; what CSV structure is needed?
title_original: BBIM 4D resource schedule import csv
question_paraphrase: key error: Activity/Resource Name when importing resource csv, tried several ifc files, cant find the right csv format
context_given: work schedule and cost schedule CSVs
phrasing_notes: pastes error text, calls the feature a game changer for QS in Ghana
answer_summary: Headers are fixed; use official template; saving from LibreOffice failed while Excel export worked; schedule of rates import still failed.

gloss_en: Hardest part is getting colleagues in Ghana to adopt Bonsai; documentation still seems crude to newcomers.

gloss_en: Workflow tips: legend placeholder objects inflate schedule quantities, grid lines regenerate, levels must exist in drawings; export IFC to FBX for Lumion.

question_paraphrase: legend objects are modelled as placeholders and must be filtered out of schedules; adjust IfcAxis limits before creating drawings; use ifcGit to undo errors
context_given: IFC to FBX to Lumion rendering
phrasing_notes: practical tips list
answer_summary: Filter legend placeholders; use ifcGit for undo; Inkscape for line cleanup.

gloss_en: Difference between Add Fitting and Add Bend for pipe/duct/cable segments; Ghana plumbing sense of fitting.
title_original: UI discussion around 'Add Fitting' and 'Add Bend'
question_paraphrase: whats the difference between add fitting and add bend for duct/pipe/cable carrier segments?
phrasing_notes: terminology confusion, local plumbing term
answer_summary: Fitting is broad (tees, wyes, caps, reducers); bend is one type; IFC4.3 suggests JUNCTION and TRANSITION; MEP tools immature; hotkey changed.

gloss_en: Ghana term for building up cost from resources is rate build-up; BIM cost schedules limited (formulas informational only, groups static).
title_original: [How to] Create a custom Qto calculation (rate build-up)
question_paraphrase: in ghana we call it rate build-up; can resources feed a schedule of rates?
context_given: Brazil calls it unit price composition
phrasing_notes: regional terminology note
answer_summary: Treat crew as one resource of quantity 1; schedules of rates cannot take resources directly yet; decimal precision bug reported.

gloss_en: Developer converting quadrant bearing strings to decimal degrees; asks how other locales write bearings; a Ghana surveyor reports DMS to decimal workflow.
title_original: Quadrant Bearings
question_paraphrase: do other countries write bearings differently than N 45 14 32.2 E? decimal point or comma for seconds?
phrasing_notes: short, domain survey jargon
answer_summary: Surveyors in Ghana use 045 14 32.2 DMS and convert to decimal degrees 45.24228.

gloss_en: Give concrete volume per element type and estimated rebar tonnage using kg/m3 ratios
prompt: pull concrete volumes for beams cols and slabs, then estimate rebar at 120 kg/m3 beams, 150 cols, and slab mesh 4.5 kg/m2. need BoQ table
expected_behavior: Read NetVolume/GrossVolume and area quantities, group by IfcBeam/IfcColumn/IfcSlab, apply given ratios, output table with totals and note missing quantities.

gloss_en: Count proxies and list their Revit categories
prompt: half my walls came thru as proxy again. how many IfcBuildingElementProxy and which revit categories
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by Category/ObjectType property, suggest IfcExportAs fixes.

gloss_en: Check glazing area under 15 percent of floor area per room for a SANS 10400 XA style check
prompt: council submission tomorrow. check glazing vs floor area per space, flag any room over 15% and any with ventilation openings under 5%
expected_behavior: Compute per-IfcSpace floor area and window/opening areas via boundaries or containment, flag rooms exceeding/below thresholds, state assumptions.

gloss_en: Report IfcMapConversion, EPSG and units of the loaded model
prompt: whats the CRS in this file? epsg, eastings northings, rotation, and are the map units metres or feet
expected_behavior: Read IfcProjectedCRS and IfcMapConversion, report EPSG name, eastings/northings/height, rotation scale, map unit versus project length unit.

gloss_en: Compare placement origins of two discipline models to see why they do not overlay
prompt: arch and struct ifc dont line up. compare their site placement and map conversion, tell me the offset and rotation between them
expected_behavior: Load both files, compare IfcSite placement and IfcMapConversion, compute offset and rotation, suggest IfcPatch offset fix.

gloss_en: Export a BoQ grouped by element type with unit and quantity
prompt: make a bill of quantities from the model - walls m2, slabs m3, doors nr, group by type name, csv
expected_behavior: Extract Qto values per type, units, aggregate, produce CSV-ready table, flag elements lacking quantities.

gloss_en: Make a door and window schedule with sizes and fire rating
prompt: door and window schedule pls - mark, type, width, height, level, fire rating if there is one
expected_behavior: List IfcDoor/IfcWindow with name, type, OverallWidth/Height, storey, FireRating from Pset; report missing values.

gloss_en: Find elements missing material or classification
prompt: which elements have no material and no classification? client wants it clean before handover
expected_behavior: Scan elements for material associations and classification references, list counts by class and examples.

gloss_en: Add a custom classification and assign to walls by type
prompt: add our firm classification list (csv attached) and tag all walls by type name. dont touch other stuff
expected_behavior: Create IfcClassification and references from CSV, assign to IfcWall elements by type, report counts, leave other data unchanged.

gloss_en: List spaces with names, areas and department for an FM handover
prompt: can you list all spaces with area and which dept, and which have no name or number
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with LongName, area quantity, department property; flag unnamed/unnumbered spaces.

gloss_en: Compare two revisions of the structural model
prompt: compare rev B to rev C of the struct model - what columns and beams were added, deleted, moved
expected_behavior: Match elements by GlobalId, report added/removed/changed placement or type, summarise by class.

gloss_en: Summarise pipe segments and fittings by system
prompt: list pipe lengths and fittings per system, plumbing only. how many bends vs tees
expected_behavior: Group IfcPipeSegment length and IfcPipeFitting by predefined type per IfcSystem, tabulate.

gloss_en: Why does my IFC from Revit show everything as proxy and where do I fix it
prompt: my ifc export from revit all shows proxy in the viewer?? which setting do i change
expected_behavior: Explain IFC export class mapping and IfcExportAs overrides, suggest checking export setup and model view definition.

gloss_en: How to put rate build-up (labour, plant, material) against BoQ items in IFC
prompt: how do i do rate build up for each BoQ item in IFC? labour plant material then overhead
expected_behavior: Explain IfcCostSchedule/IfcCostItem with IfcConstructionResource, tools support limits, workaround with CSV.

gloss_en: Check the site elevation and survey point placement
prompt: what is the site ref elevation and where is the survey point? is the model far from origin
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite RefElevation, placement, IfcMapConversion; report distance of bounding box from origin and warn about precision.

gloss_en: Check model against a simple requirements list (IDS-like) for public-client delivery
prompt: client says each wall needs FireRating and IsExternal, each space needs a number. does this model pass? list failures
expected_behavior: Check required properties on IfcWall and IfcSpace, report pass/fail counts and failing GlobalIds.
